Larger-gain research, prepared for Dominik with substantial OpenAI Codex
(GPT-6 Astra) assistance, October 2026. New material is provided under the
repository's Apache-2.0 license.

This directory builds on PR564 at c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935
and its inherited complex-allcold package. Its upstream construction,
provider, compiler, exact arithmetic, scheduling and bit-supplier notices
remain applicable. The repository NOTICE and the notices in the unchanged
research/complex-allcold, research/direct-delivery504-global and referenced
vendor packages are retained and incorporated by reference.

The current work contributes extra checked suffix kernels, coupled entrance
frame promotions, whole-owner repacking, exact dual exclusions for finite
capacity and stage models, bounded geometry/architecture screens and
hypothetical cost-sensitivity targets. Source copies preserve their original
headers; adaptation manifests distinguish unchanged and modified files.
The stage nomination screen derives from Rohan Arun's retained complex501
stage search. Provider frame and word routines retain the credited work of
DreamingOfClouds, icekylinx and their cited contributors, including the
earlier scalar, phase, frame, gauge, kernel and dirty-restoration ancestry.

No priority claim is made for inherited constructions, the capacity-pattern
LP used in PR563, or graph minrank/product methods. Exact finite checks and
model-specific dual bounds are not an unconditional multiplication theorem,
a full Lean proof, or a worst-case constant-time indexing result.
